audit.why: 57.84% over 389 games — strong Naafiri lane. He is stackless and immobile early, you win every stage until his 2+ item infinite scaling. Pressure early, end early.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full phases[5].side said 'Aurelion Sol' against content win[5]='Naafiri' (two-layer disagreement); phases[3]/[4] were blanket 'Skill'; phases[6] had side Aurelion Sol with a why describing Naafiri winning — the exact side/why contradiction QA reverted 189 of.
audit.why: Packet chart: Naafiri 1 through first item, Aurelion Sol only at 2+ items; content whys agree.
audit.corrected: Sides aligned with why rewrites for every changed row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content names the ult 'Stellar Nova' — fabricated; the real R is Falling Star / The Skies Descend, and it is described as a pull-and-stun channel, which it is not (the pull is Singularity, E). Missing decisive facts: Singularity's center executes below a threshold and its damage bypasses resistance stacking; Astral Flight is 22s at rank 1 (his only escape); Naafiri W untargetability can blank the Falling Star impact.
audit.why: Riot text: R 'crashes a star... stuns'; E 'black hole... executes enemies below a certain (threshold)', percentHealth flag; W CD 22/20.5/19/17.5/16.
audit.corrected: All 'Stellar Nova' references replaced; execute and cooldowns written in.

edits.before: W-diving into held CC — the lock-on telegraphs, the dogs can't dodge, and the lane's one button answers everything.
edits.after: Diving into a held Falling Star — the 1250-range stun catches the pack mid-commit and his breath melts the pile.

edits.before: - Aurelion Sol Astral Flight: matchup-defining — His reposition and escape — he is a stationary battery while it is down. It governs your forward steps. - E Eviscerate spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Aurelion Sol Astral Flight: matchup-defining — a 22s cooldown at rank 1. His reposition and escape — he is a stationary battery while it is down. - Singularity is 12s and Falling Star 120s — with both down he cannot peel the pack. Hold your R for the fight that decides something.

edits.before: Good trade: Q the bleed, Q the consume, E through with the pack piling — a six-body trade he answered with one rotation. Bad trade: W-diving into held CC — the lock-on telegraphs, the dogs can't dodge, and the lane's one button answers everything.
edits.after: Good trade: Q the bleed, Q the consume, E through with the pack piling — a six-body trade he answered with one rotation. Bad trade: diving into a held Falling Star — the 1250-range stun catches the pack mid-commit and his breath melts the pile.

edits.before: You are the flank with a head count: R the approach, W through the front line, and let the hounds peel-proof the exit.
edits.after: Never fight low inside Singularity — its center executes below a threshold and the pull drags you back toward it.

edits.before: W-diving into held CC — the lock-on telegraphs, the dogs can't dodge, and the lane's one button answers everything.
edits.after: Blind shoves feed his roam game — Astral Flight flies him 1500 range over walls to a fight you never saw coming.

edits.before: W online: the lock-on dive threatens anyone past the wave's midline. The lane plays scared now.
edits.after: Full Q-W-E online: your combo out-trades his unstacked breath everywhere past the wave's midline.

edits.before: R online: the vision sweep plus bigger pack makes every roam a scheduled accident for a side lane.
edits.after: Hounds' Pursuit online: your instant 900-range all-in beats his slow E pull and R setup — dive first.

edits.before: First item spike: the W dive plus full string deletes squishies. Hunt the half-bars.
edits.after: First item spike: W-E still deletes his fragile stacking frame — hunt before he stacks.

edits.before: Late Naafiri flanks: R the sweep, W the carry, and let the pack vote on the peel.
edits.after: Stacked range, perma-slow and Falling Star peel your all-in — end the game early.

edits.before: Your level-6 R bursts him before his slow Stellar Nova channels.
edits.after: Your level-6 R bursts him before his Falling Star and pull land.

edits.before: Your R all-in beats his: his R Stellar Nova is a slow, telegraphed pull-and-stun that your W dash can burst him before he channels it fully. Pop Call of the Pack for the extra hounds and healing and kill him before his star stacks matter.
edits.after: Your R all-in beats his: Falling Star is a telegraphed 1250-range stun, and W's untargetable window can blank the impact. Pop The Call of the Pack for extra hounds and attack damage and kill him before his star stacks matter.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay yours. Your combo and Packmate damage out-trade his unstacked breath, and at 6 your fast R all-in beats his slow, channelled Stellar Nova as long as you dash on top of him before he fully casts it.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay yours. Your combo and Packmate damage out-trade his unstacked breath, and at 6 your fast R all-in beats his telegraphed Falling Star as long as you dash on top of him before the stun lands.

notes: Fabricated ult name 'Stellar Nova' killed in all four content locations; it also misdescribed the ability (the pull is Singularity, not R). phases[5] was a live two-layer chart disagreement (full: Aurelion Sol, content: Naafiri) — resolved to Naafiri per packet and content why. Side edits go alone where win[] already agrees. The old spikes[1] claimed W gives healing — it gives Move Speed and AD only; removed. 'His R displacement' in content late/spikes[3] refers to The Skies Descend's drag — plausible from Riot's truncated text, left alone and listed unverified. Packet defect 'no sequencing advice' is addressed by the new cooldowns field (wait for Astral Flight/Singularity/Falling Star before committing).
